findings.issue: Note calls さ the 'negative/passive stem' of する. さ is the mizenkei used for passive/causative (される/させる) only; the negative of する is しない (stem し), never さない. Teaches a false conjugation.
findings.current: raiz negativa/passiva de する → さ (antes de れる)
findings.suggested: raiz (未然形) de する usada na passiva: さ + れる → される

findings.issue: Added intensifier 'really' has no counterpart in 髪を短くしました (just 短く, 'short'). The expl itself glosses it as plain 'to make short'.
findings.current: I cut my hair really short.

findings.issue: 'bem curtinho' adds intensity/diminutive absent from the JP (短くしました = 'deixei curto', no とても/すごく). Contradicts the item's own expl_pt ('deixar o cabelo curto').
Literal mirror renders 髪を (object, を) as the topic device 'As for my hair', misrepresenting the object marker as は-topicalization.
findings.current: As for my hair, I made it short.

findings.issue: Espelho literal usa 'Quanto ao cabelo' (dispositivo de tópico は) para 髪を, que é objeto direto marcado por を — o espelho estrutural fica incorreto.
Literal mirror uses 'As for me' (the は-topic device) but the particle is が (私が, subject). Other が-sentences in the corpus (e.g. 絵が, 安全が) correctly avoid 'As for'.
findings.current: As for me, I (humbly) carry the luggage.

findings.issue: 'Quanto a mim' espelha o tópico は, mas a partícula é が (私が, sujeito). O espelho literal deve distinguir が de は.
findings.current: Quanto a mim, faço (humildemente) o ato de carregar a bagagem.
findings.suggested: Eu (sujeito) faço (humildemente) o ato de carregar a bagagem.

findings.issue: Literal mirror uses 'As for the new shoes' (は-topic device) but the particle is が (靴が, subject); misrepresents が as topicalization.
findings.current: As for the new shoes, they shine beautifully.

findings.issue: 'Quanto aos sapatos novos' espelha tópico は, mas a frase usa が (sujeito). O espelho estrutural fica incorreto.
findings.current: Quanto aos sapatos novos, (eles) brilham de forma bonita.
findings.suggested: Os sapatos novos (sujeito) brilham de forma bonita.

findings.issue: お祭り is labeled 'núcleo do tópico', but the head of the topic phrase お祭りの夜 is 夜 (already tagged 'tópico'); お祭り is the の-linked modifier, not the nucleus.
findings.suggested: modificador (ligado a 夜 por の)

findings.issue: そんなに is glossed as 'that... after all', which is not a meaning of そんなに ('that much / to that extent'); the pt version correctly has 'tão... assim'.
findings.current: そんなに ('that... after all') grades the adjective.
findings.suggested: そんなに ('that much / all that') grades the adjective.

findings.issue: English word 'polite' left untranslated in the pt-BR explanation; should be 'polida'.
findings.current: O verbo está na forma negativa polite: 分かりません (分かり + ませ + ん).
findings.suggested: O verbo está na forma negativa polida: 分かりません (分かり + ませ + ん).

findings.issue: Missing space before the opening parenthesis ('dia(cumprimento').
Missing space before the opening parenthesis in the token gloss ('dia(cumprimento').
